testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.publish.PublishScopeScenarioTests

testcase.name: a publish overtaken by a newer intent fails explicitly as STALE_PUBLISH and never moves the pointer()
a publish that waits longer than allowed ends FAILED with SCOPE_BUSY, and the site is untouched()
a deployment whose number is below the pointer's fails STALE_PUBLISH through the whole pipeline()
publishes that race end in order - the pointer is never older than the newest activated intent, nothing is lost or doubled()
a publish that finds the scope owned does not fail - it waits, writes one SCOPE_BUSY event, and completes once the scope is free()
a worker that died in DEPLOYING is taken over - the redelivered deployment resumes under a new fencing token and completes once()
